description: This file defines a singleton class 'TerminationSignalWatcher' that observes system signals like SIGTERM and SIGINT to initiate a graceful shutdown process, including stopping pairing prompts, terminating the application, and scheduling an exit fallback.

classes.name: TerminationSignalWatcher
classes.description: A singleton class that listens for termination signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT) to perform cleanup and shutdown procedures safely.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT if not already active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Removes all signal handlers and resets internal state related to termination.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up a signal handler for a specific signal number, ignoring the default, and attaching an event handler.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles received signals by setting the termination flag, logging, stopping pairing prompts, terminating the app, and scheduling a forced exit as a safety net.
